title: 47th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/47/2024).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 39/2024 to 42/2024).

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Education Dr Ismail Shafeeu: the planned Dharumavantha School hall was to be built on the current Malé Jail site, which the minister said in December 2023 would be vacated and handed to the school; the MP asks how far that work has progressed and when it will be completed.
Continued debate on the Bill amending the Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted on behalf of the government by Maafushi MP Hussain Riza Adam.
Economic Committee report on the President's nominee for Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation (Article 8(a) of the Tax Administration Act, Law No. 3/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, questioned the Education Minister about the Dharumavantha School hall on the Malé Jail site, continued the Penal Code amendment debate and took up a committee report on a tax-office nominee.
